why: Both analyses reach nearly the same diagnosis (abandon growth-for-size, narrow to the home-state franchise, cut cost, stop energy/shipping/developing-country lending) and both list all four key brutal facts and the decline pattern. Analysis 1 edges ahead by naming cost as the weakest link, explicitly including executive perks in its stop-doing list and giving a tighter verdict, while Analysis 2 is slightly better calibrated because it explains its score and avoids placeholder numeric targets.
